name: quote_create
description: Quote a client: line items with quantity and unit price in minor units, VAT per line or the business default, an optional discount and a validity window. Returns the quote id and the totals.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Client name or id. A name the invoice server already knows brings its address, email and VAT id onto the quote

arguments.name: items
arguments.desc: The line items being quoted

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: Defaults to your business default currency

arguments.name: validity_days
arguments.desc: Days the quote stays valid, counted from the quote date and inclusive. Default 30

arguments.name: valid_until
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, an explicit last valid day. Wins over validity_days

arguments.name: issue_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in your business profile's timezone

arguments.name: discount_percent
arguments.desc: Discount applied to every line, in percent

arguments.name: tax_rate
arguments.desc: VAT percent for lines with no rate of their own. Defaults to the business default

arguments.name: notes
arguments.desc: Free text printed under the totals, e.g. scope or exclusions

arguments.name: client_email
arguments.desc: Only if the user gave it; otherwise the stored client's email is used

arguments.name: client_address
arguments.desc: Postal address for the QUOTE FOR block, newlines allowed

arguments.name: client_vat_id
arguments.desc: Client VAT / tax registration id

name: quote_list
description: Every quote with its client, total, validity and state (open, expired, accepted or declined). Filter by state, by client or by quote date range.

arguments.name: state
arguments.desc: Default "all". "open" excludes quotes whose validity has run out; "expired" is only those

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Only quotes for clients whose name contains this text

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, earliest quote date

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, latest quote date

name: quote_get
description: The full stored record for one quote: every line with its unit price and VAT, the totals, the validity date, the notes and, when it was accepted, the invoice it became.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Quote id such as Q-2026-0001, or an exact client name

name: quote_update
description: Revise a quote that is still open: line items, currency, discount, VAT default, validity or notes. Totals are recomputed. An accepted or declined quote is never edited.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Quote id such as Q-2026-0001

arguments.name: items
arguments.desc: Replaces every line item

arguments.name: tax_rate
arguments.desc: VAT percent for lines with no rate of their own

arguments.name: validity_days
arguments.desc: Recomputes valid_until from the quote date

arguments.name: valid_until
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD. Wins over validity_days, and is how an expired quote is extended

name: quote_send_text
description: Turn a quote into a plain-text summary with the line table, the VAT lines, the total and the validity date, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Quote id such as Q-2026-0001

arguments.name: greeting
arguments.desc: Opening line, default "Hello" plus the client name

arguments.name: sign_off
arguments.desc: Closing line, default your business name from the shared profile

name: quote_accept
description: Mark a quote accepted and turn it into an invoice: created directly in the invoice server when its store is present, otherwise returned as invoice_create-ready line items. The numbers are copied, never recomputed.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Quote id such as Q-2026-0001

arguments.name: create_invoice
arguments.desc: Default "auto": create the invoice when the invoice store exists, otherwise hand back the items. "never" only marks it accepted

arguments.name: issue_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD for the invoice, defaults to today

arguments.name: due_days
arguments.desc: Days until the invoice is due, defaults to your payment terms

arguments.name: allow_expired
arguments.desc: Accept a quote whose validity has run out. Default false: an expired quote is refused so the price is re-confirmed first

name: quote_decline
description: Mark a quote as lost, with an optional reason, so it stops counting against the open quotes and shows up in the win rate. An accepted quote is never turned back.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Quote id such as Q-2026-0001

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: Why it was lost, e.g. "price" or "went in-house". Kept on the record

arguments.name: date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today

name: quote_pdf
description: Call this tool to write the A4 PDF of one quote and return the file path. Same layout as the invoice PDF, with the validity date and an acceptance block. Pro.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Quote id such as Q-2026-0001

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. Defaults to the quotes data directory under pdf/

name: quote_report
description: Totals per currency for open, accepted, declined and expired quotes, with counts, the value still open and the win rate. Pro.

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, earliest quote date to count

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, latest quote date to count

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
